WITH pack_links AS (
  SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack
  UNION
  SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member
),
ran2_dispositions AS (
  SELECT dp.target AS document_id, dp.code AS disposition, m.label AS wg_meeting
  FROM disposition AS dp
  JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id
  JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
  WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(dp.evidence_status), ' ', ''), '-', ''), '_', '')) = 'sourceverified'
    AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(dp.scope), ' ', ''), '-', ''), '_', '')) IN ('document', 'wholedocument', 'wholedoc')
    AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(m.wg), ' ', ''), '-', ''), '_', '')) = 'ran2'
),
section_links AS (
  SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
  UNION
  SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.number AS document, rd.disposition AS disposition, rd.wg_meeting AS wg_meeting, p.pack_number AS cr_pack
FROM document AS d
JOIN pack_links AS pl ON pl.cr = d.id
JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = pl.pack_id
JOIN ran2_dispositions AS rd ON rd.document_id = d.id
JOIN section_links AS sl ON sl.cr = d.id
JOIN section AS s ON s.id = sl.section_id
WHERE p.pack_number LIKE 'RP-%'
  AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(d.target_release), ' ', ''), '-', ''), '_', '')) IN ('17', 'rel17', 'release17', 'r17')
  AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(d.spec)), '3GPP', ''), 'TS', ''), ' ', '') = '38.321'
  AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(s.spec)), '3GPP', ''), 'TS', ''), ' ', '') = '38.321'
